summary: Remove iOS 12 Safari-incompatible syntax and APIs from the local Mission Control app, and add a targeted compatibility gate plus an exact reversible Opal static-file update.

evidence.failure: The app used optional chaining and nullish coalescing (Safari 14+) and a private class method (Safari 15+); iOS 12 also has partial AbortController fetch-abort behavior, and globalThis is unavailable in iOS 12 Safari.
validation: Focused Node regression suite: 17/17 passed, including old command/readback behavior, identity enablement, timeout/error handling, iOS 12 unsupported syntax/API gate, and isolated update plus exact rollback rehearsal.
Shell syntax checks and package SHA256SUMS validation passed.
Actual iPad mini 2 and physical lighting validation remain required after the exact package is authorized and installed.
evidence.rollback: Run /www/mission-control-local/rollback-update.sh after v1.0.1 installation; it restores and hash-verifies the exact v1.0.0 static files saved at /root/hbnf-mission-control-local.rollback-v1.0.0. No firmware, router services/configuration, relay, or device settings change.
